transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

When there’s a line or a process, I just can’t seem to wait my turn without jumping ahead or changing plans, and it keeps messing up our money and appointments. It’s putting a huge strain on my family, and I'm just really stressed about how much this is hurting our finances.
Do you often act on impulses without thinking about the consequences, even if it’s something that could harm you or your relationships?

Yes, I do that constantly, like making impulsive purchases we can't afford or leaving lines because I'm impatient, which makes us lose our benefits. I also blurt out answers and agree to things in meetings before I even understand them. It actually got so bad we almost got evicted recently, which really terrified my wife and strained our household.

The persistent pattern of impulsivity, difficulty waiting, and lifelong functional impairment strongly supports F90.0 (hyperkinetic disorder) as the most consistent diagnosis. The symptoms described—impulsive decisions, financial consequences, interpersonal strain, and early onset—are characteristic of this condition.
